note: SCOPE FALSIFICATION SET. Aimed at the ONE named defect the blind run exposed: BOUNDED -> UNBOUNDED ENTAILMENT DRIFT. The model understands the basic relation and silently widens its scope. ⛔ This is not a general accuracy set — it is built to break DeBERTa at its characterized boundary, on fresh material.
why_this_matters: For a long-lived semantic graph the drift is corrosive rather than dramatic: past->present, sometimes->generally, participated->member, temporary->enduring, one instance->stable property. Each is a small widening that no single reading looks wrong.
freeze: Frozen at commit. An expectation moves ONLY by a recorded founder adjudication that preserves the original, as N2 did.
label_rule: ⛔ The verdict is ENTAILED vs NOT ENTAILED. `neutral` and `contradiction` are RECORDED DIAGNOSTICS ONLY. Neither may be read as 'the source says the opposite' — blind B12 is why.

expected_values.entailed: the premise commits to the hypothesis
expected_values.not_entailed: the premise does not commit (neutral) OR denies it (contradiction)

cases.premise: Imre managed the bakery until it closed in 2019.
cases.hypothesis: Imre manages the bakery.
cases.origin: ⭐ The B21 defect, fresh domain. An explicitly closed interval read as current.

cases.premise: Imre has managed the bakery since 2019 and still opens it each morning.
cases.hypothesis: Imre manages the bakery.
cases.origin: Same family, licensed and current.

cases.premise: Bea served on the lifeboat for a decade before moving inland.
cases.hypothesis: Bea serves on the lifeboat.
cases.origin: Harder: long duration, so the past reads substantial, and the cessation is a subordinate clause.

cases.premise: Dara has covered the night shift twice this year.
cases.hypothesis: Dara works the night shift.
cases.origin: Two instances read as a standing arrangement.

cases.premise: Dara works every night shift on the rota and has not missed one.
cases.hypothesis: Dara works the night shift.
cases.origin: Same family, licensed.

cases.premise: Aziz was invited to sit in on the swim club's training session.
cases.hypothesis: Aziz belongs to the swim club.
cases.origin: ⭐ The B05 defect, fresh domain. A guest at one session is not a member.

cases.premise: Aziz has paid dues to the swim club for six years.
cases.hypothesis: Aziz belongs to the swim club.
cases.origin: Same family, licensed by a membership fact rather than the word member.

cases.premise: The catalogue lists her among the contributors to the atlas.
cases.hypothesis: She is one of the atlas's editors.
cases.origin: Harder: a real, recorded role widened to a different and larger one.

cases.premise: Mira is covering the archive desk while the archivist is on leave.
cases.hypothesis: Mira is the archivist.
cases.origin: Standing in for a role is not holding it.

cases.premise: Mira was appointed archivist last year and holds the post still.
cases.hypothesis: Mira is the archivist.
cases.origin: Same family, licensed.

cases.premise: Several of the orchard's pear trees were lost to blight.
cases.hypothesis: The orchard's pear trees were lost to blight.
cases.origin: Quantifier dropped. The bare plural reads as the whole set.

cases.premise: Every pear tree in the orchard was lost to blight.
cases.hypothesis: The orchard's pear trees were lost to blight.
cases.origin: Same hypothesis, universally licensed.

cases.premise: The kiln failed during Tuesday's firing.
cases.hypothesis: The kiln fails when it is fired.
cases.origin: One occurrence read as a dispositional property.

cases.premise: The kiln has failed in every firing since March.
cases.hypothesis: The kiln fails when it is fired.
cases.origin: Same hypothesis, licensed by an exhaustive pattern.

cases.premise: Wren intends to repaint the lighthouse this summer.
cases.hypothesis: Wren repainted the lighthouse.
cases.origin: Intention is not performance.

cases.premise: Wren repainted the lighthouse over three weeks in June.
cases.hypothesis: Wren repainted the lighthouse.
cases.origin: Same hypothesis, performed.

cases.premise: The depot will take delivery of the new engines in March.
cases.hypothesis: The depot has the new engines.
cases.origin: Scheduled is not held.

cases.premise: The depot took delivery of the new engines in March and they sit in the shed.
cases.hypothesis: The depot has the new engines.
cases.origin: Same hypothesis, delivered and still held.

cases.premise: Sofia can read Old Norse.
cases.hypothesis: Sofia reads Old Norse manuscripts in the reading room.
cases.origin: ⭐ Ability is not exercise. The widening that turns a capacity into a practice.

cases.premise: Sofia spends each Thursday reading Old Norse manuscripts in the reading room.
cases.hypothesis: Sofia reads Old Norse manuscripts in the reading room.
cases.origin: Same hypothesis, exercised.

cases.premise: Nils supplies timber to the boatyard.
cases.hypothesis: Nils is a boatbuilder.
cases.origin: Supplying a trade is not practising it.

cases.premise: Nils has built boats at the yard for thirty years.
cases.hypothesis: Nils is a boatbuilder.
cases.origin: Same hypothesis, licensed by the work itself.
